svg.title: Mind Map Studio: safe with your data
svg.desc: A looping animation in four scenes. 1: a new node is typed and the badge goes from Saving… to Saved, because every change is saved in the browser (IndexedDB); after a reload the map is unchanged and Ctrl+Z still undoes the new node. 2: Project, Save snapshot… saves a snapshot named Before pricing change; the Snapshots list shows it with an earlier one, and restoring is one step you can undo. 3: on the start screen a project is moved to the Trash, where it shows deleted forever in 30 days, and Restore brings it back. 4: Back up all projects downloads one ZIP with the projects, their snapshots, custom presets and pictures, but not the Trash; the storage meter offers Keep my data; and when another tab changed the same project, this tab’s edits are saved as a copy.

g.text: Undo still works after the reload
Saved in this browser (IndexedDB), at least every 5 seconds even while you keep typing.
Every change is saved in your browser, and undo survives a reload.
Named copies of this project you can go back to. Restoring is one step you can undo.
Save a snapshot before a big change; restore it in one undoable step.
Delete projects forever after 30 days in the trash
The Trash is not part of a backup.
A Trash with 30 days to change your mind
A removed project waits in the Trash; Restore brings it back.
One ZIP of the whole library, with pictures.
The browser may clear this data if the device runs low on space.
Protected: the browser will not clear this data to free space.
Both tabs keep their edits; nothing is overwritten.
Backed up 3 projects. Keep the ZIP somewhere safe; Import restores it.
“Launch plan” was changed in another tab.
Your edits from this tab were saved as “Launch plan (conflict copy)”.
One ZIP backs up everything; Keep my data asks the browser not to clear it.
